author: Wahiz
body:
This thread is for users to challenge a rule and mods will have a look at it and see if it should be removed or not.

The Ninja Kit For CTW/Nexus:

Rule: Boots must be on at all times!

Challenge:

Since the server completely went to 1.8 you can now see nametags even though the player is invisible so why have the rule set in place to make sure you wear the boots? Makes no sense..

What do you think?

Feel Free to challenge some rules you think need to be removed or changed. But you must have a good reason on why it should be changed or removed.

Thanks!

-Dawson
